from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "We translate new coordinates using matrix multiplication.",
            "Matrix P converts pirate coordinates to standard ones.",
            "P-inverse performs the reverse translation back to the pirate.",
            "The formula [v]_standard equals P times [v]_new.",
            "This math keeps everyone's perspective perfectly aligned."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("The Mathematical Transformation", lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        WHITE_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"
        YELLOW_COLOR = "#FFFF00"
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # We translate new coordinates using matrix multiplication.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW_COLOR)
        formula = MathTex(r"[\vec{v}]_{std} = P \cdot [\vec{v}]_{new}", color=WHITE_COLOR)
        self.place_in_area(formula, 'B1', 'B6', scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Matrix P converts pirate coordinates to standard ones.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW_COLOR)
        
        matrix_p_def = MathTex(r"P = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}", color=WHITE_COLOR)
        self.place_in_area(matrix_p_def, 'C1', 'C6', scale_factor=0.9)
        self.play(FadeIn(matrix_p_def, shift=UP*0.2))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # P-inverse performs the reverse translation back to the pirate.
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW_COLOR)
        
        p_inv_text = MathTex(r"[\vec{v}]_{new} = P^{-1} \cdot [\vec{v}]_{std}", color=WHITE_COLOR)
        self.place_in_area(p_inv_text, 'D1', 'D6', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(Write(p_inv_text))
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Transition: Remove P-inverse and P def to make room for substitution
        self.play(FadeOut(p_inv_text), FadeOut(matrix_p_def))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # The formula [v]_standard equals P times [v]_new.
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(YELLOW_COLOR)
        
        v_new_pirate = MathTex(r"[\vec{v}]_{new} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}", color=YELLOW_COLOR)
        self.place_in_area(v_new_pirate, 'C1', 'C6', scale_factor=0.9)
        
        substitution = MathTex(
            r"[\vec{v}]_{std} =", r"\begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}", r"\begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}",
            color=WHITE_COLOR
        )
        substitution[2].set_color(YELLOW_COLOR)
        self.place_in_area(substitution, 'D1', 'D6', scale_factor=0.9)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(v_new_pirate))
        # Transform the original generic formula to the specific substituted version
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(formula, substitution[0]))
        self.play(FadeIn(substitution[1:]))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # This math keeps everyone's perspective perfectly aligned.
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(YELLOW_COLOR)
        
        # Calculation: [2*1 - 1*1; 1*1 + 1*1] = [1; 2]
        result_vec_math = MathTex(r"[\vec{v}]_{std} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \end{bmatrix}", color=WHITE_COLOR)
        self.place_in_area(result_vec_math, 'D1', 'D6', scale_factor=0.9)
        
        self.play(Transform(substitution, result_vec_math))
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Show grid and highlight [1, 2]
        # Standard grid area E1-F6
        grid = NumberPlane(
            x_range=[-1, 4, 1], y_range=[-1, 4, 1],
            background_line_style={"stroke_opacity": 0.4},
            axis_config={"include_tip": True}
        )
        # Wrap in VGroup to use grid system
        grid_group = VGroup(grid)
        self.place_in_area(grid_group, 'E1', 'F6', scale_factor=0.5)
        
        v_std_arrow = Arrow(
            start=grid.coords_to_point(0, 0),
            end=grid.coords_to_point(1, 2),
            buff=0,
            color=WHITE_COLOR
        )
        v_std_label = MathTex(r"[1, 2]", color=WHITE_COLOR, font_size=20)
        v_std_label.next_to(v_std_arrow.get_end(), UR, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(
            Create(grid), 
            FadeOut(v_new_pirate), 
            substitution.animate.scale(0.8).move_to(self.grid['C4'])
        )
        self.play(GrowArrow(v_std_arrow), Write(v_std_label))
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP, buff=0.3)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        # Shifted right to avoid overlap with lecture text (Belief B021)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Centering the grid on the right half of the screen
                x_coord = 1.5 + j * 0.85
                y_coord = 2.2 - i * 0.85
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x_coord, y_coord, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Layout
        title = "Change of Basis: Different Perspectives"
        lecture_notes = [
            "A basis is a set of vectors",
            "used to measure space.",
            "",
            "Standard Basis (i, j):",
            "The default 'grid'.",
            "",
            "Alternative Basis (b1, b2):",
            "Seeing the world",
            "through a different lens."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_notes)

        # 2. Define Coordinate System in the Grid
        # Center the coordinate system at the middle of our visual area (around D4)
        origin_point = self.grid["D4"]
        
        plane = NumberPlane(
            x_range=[-2, 2, 1],
            y_range=[-2, 2, 1],
            x_length=3.5,
            y_length=3.5,
            axis_config={"include_tip": True, "stroke_width": 2},
            background_line_style={"stroke_opacity": 0.3}
        ).move_to(origin_point)

        # 3. Create Vector and Label
        # Vector v = [1, 1] in standard basis
        vec_v = Arrow(
            plane.get_origin(), 
            plane.c2p(1, 1), 
            buff=0, 
            color=YELLOW, 
            stroke_width=4
        )
        
        # Use MathTex for coordinates (Belief B050)
        coords_label = MathTex(
            r"\vec{v} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}_s", 
            color=YELLOW, 
            font_size=30
        )
        self.place_at_grid(coords_label, "A4")

        # 4. Animation Sequence
        self.play(Create(plane), run_time=1)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_v), Write(coords_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # 5. Transformation: Change of Basis
        # New basis vectors: b1 = [1, 0.5], b2 = [0.5, 1]
        basis_change_matrix = [[1, 0.5], [0.5, 1]]
        
        new_plane = plane.copy().apply_matrix(basis_change_matrix)
        new_plane.set_color(BLUE)
        
        # New coordinates in basis B: v = [0.66, 0.66] roughly, 
        # but for clarity let's show the transformation of the grid
        new_label = MathTex(
            r"\vec{v} = \begin{bmatrix} x' \\ y' \end{bmatrix}_B", 
            color=BLUE, 
            font_size=30
        )
        self.place_at_grid(new_label, "A4")

        basis_text = Text("Basis Changed", font_size=20, color=BLUE)
        self.place_at_grid(basis_text, "A6")

        self.play(
            Transform(plane, new_plane),
            Transform(coords_label, new_label),
            FadeIn(basis_text),
            run_time=2.5
        )
        
        self.wait(2)

        # 6. Final Highlight
        # Keep the vector fixed in physical space while the grid moves underneath it
        self.play(
            Indicate(vec_v, color=WHITE),
            self.lecture[6:].animate.set_color(BLUE),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(2)
